runtimeContract.importPolicy: Dynamically import the same-origin entry only when the visitor opts into the experiment. Do not statically bundle or preload it.

baseOptions.modelAssetBuffer: Pinned model fetched into Uint8Array after opt-in

runtimeContract.wrapperAssetPolicy: createHandLandmarker(taskOptions, {signal,onProgress}) downloads pinned same-origin WASM and model concurrently with real decoded-byte progress, cancellation and timeouts; pins CPU and modelAssetBuffer. It never requests a camera stream.
runtimeContract.wasmResolver: Resolve the default classic SIMD/noSIMD fileset; fetch only its selected WASM via a SHA-versioned URL, initialize from a temporary WASM Blob URL and close abandoned native results. Native initialization is serialized.
runtimeContract.videoInference: detectForVideo(videoElement, monotonicallyIncreasingTimestampInMilliseconds); skip repeated video.currentTime and throttle calls because inference is synchronous.
runtimeContract.teardown: Call task.close(); stop every owned MediaStreamTrack separately.
unusedUpstreamFilesOmitted: module-mode WASM pair (forVisionTasks useModule=true is not used)
runtimeContract.visionWasmScope: Official vision runtime contains shared vision calculators and both CPU/GPU code paths. There is no separate official hand-only WASM binary. No separate GPU, audio, gen-AI, or gesture-recognizer model is shipped.
runtimeContract.mainBundleImpact: No npm dependency or build configuration was changed.

loadingLimits.cache: ?v=<content SHA-256 first 12> enables immutable cache; Blob is revoked after real initialization settles.

persistentAssetCache.name: teamlink-hand-vision-assets-v1
persistentAssetCache.scope: Opt-in WASM and model only; exact size and SHA-256 checked before use/store. Cache key contains full content SHA. Storage failure falls back to normal fetch/HTTP cache.
persistentAssetCache.fetchLoadedMeaning: Decoded bytes returned by fetch, including ordinary HTTP cache; not a measurement of physical network transfer.
persistentAssetCache.offlineBoundary: Cached WASM/model may be reused offline; this does not guarantee the HTML or runtime JS are available offline.
